RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT (New York) — synthetic test fixture (KITCHEN SINK)
This fixture deliberately plants one prohibited or abusive clause per NY rule. It is
NOT a real or usable lease — it exists only to prove the engine flags each rule.

1. Security Deposit. The Tenant shall pay a security deposit of two months' rent. The security deposit shall be non-refundable. The Landlord may commingle the security deposit with the Landlord's own funds, and the deposit shall become the property of the Landlord.

2. Habitability. The Tenant accepts the premises as-is and waives the warranty of habitability.

3. Liability. The Tenant shall hold the Landlord harmless, and the Landlord shall not be liable for any injury caused by the Landlord's negligence.

4. Jury Trial. The Tenant waives the right to a trial by jury in any action for personal injury or property damage.

5. Default and Possession. Upon default, the Landlord may re-enter and take possession of the premises without resort to court, change the locks, and shut off utilities until the balance is paid.

6. Complaints. The Tenant shall pay a one hundred dollar penalty for filing any complaint with a housing agency, and waives any claim of retaliation.

7. Fees. The Tenant shall pay a seventy-five dollar application fee. A late fee applies to rent received after the first of the month.

8. Early Termination. Upon early termination, the Tenant shall be liable for all remaining rent for the entire term, immediately due and payable.

9. Rent Increases. The Landlord may increase the rent at any time upon ten days notice.
